result.reason: The supported generalization is already embodied in the bounded repository repair: legitimate-stop exceptions require active structured corroboration and malformed claims fail closed. Creating a prompt Candidate would duplicate an implementation-level invariant, while the existing unit-verdict Candidate already covers the only evaluator behavior exercised here.
retained_lessons: Broad stop-signal substrings are useful only after checking exact active structured exceptions.
A legitimate-stop label without corroboration must not become a bypass; reject it before native mutation.
Freshness-gate failures are executable repair tasks, not completion points.
Synthetic-matrix PASS must stay separate from exact-head publication and the user-level objective.
